name: Blue Horde
alt: Right wing of the Jochid ulus

predecessors.name: Golden Horde
predecessors.text: the western two-fifths of the Golden Horde's 1352 shape: Crimea, the North Caucasus, the Lower Volga and the Pontic steppe

successors.name: Golden Horde
successors.text: the Blue Horde's lands, reunited with the White Horde by Tokhtamysh

ledger.x: 1363: the western horde of Mamai is drawn as a state.
1373: Urus Khan of the eastern horde takes Sarai from Mamai's khan.
1380: the Blue Horde is joined to the White Horde under Tokhtamysh.

wars.name: Great Troubles
wars.outcome: Succession war after Berdi Beg's death in August 1359: Mamai makes and unmakes khans (Abdallah, Muhammad-Sultan, Tulak) while Urus Khan and then Tokhtamysh hold the eastern ulus; Tokhtamysh takes Sarai in early 1380.

wars.name: Mamai's wars with Moscow (Vozha and Kulikovo)
wars.outcome: Mamai raids Nizhny Novgorod's lands and sacks Novosil in 1375 and burns Nizhny Novgorod in 1377; his army is beaten on the Vozha on 11 August 1378 and on Kulikovo Field on 8 September 1380.

wars.name: Tokhtamysh's war on Mamai
wars.outcome: Mamai, beaten on the Kalka, is refused entry at Solkhat and Caffa and killed outside Solkhat; his lands pass to Tokhtamysh.

certainty.note: Steppe frontiers drawn approximate; the western edge follows the Dnieper as Lithuania left it after Blue Waters; the Sarai and Lower Volga seat was contested between the hordes.
